newsitem.title: FINLAND: KONECRANES UPS STAKE IN FRENCH UNIT.
newsitem.headline: KONECRANES UPS STAKE IN FRENCH UNIT.

text.p: Finnish industrial cranes maker KCI Konecranes Oy said in a statement on Wednesday it had bought the remaining 50 percent in French company CGP-Kone S.A. from GEC Alsthom for an undisclosed sum.
"KCI Konecranes has upped its holding to 100 percent in its French joint venture CGP-Kone S.A.," Konecranes said.
CGP-Kone manufactures industrial process cranes and standard cranes and sells maintainance of the products. Its 1995 net sales were over 100 million franc, Konecranes said.

"The deal means for Konecranes an independent position on the French crane market and an opportunity to develop the maintenance operation together with KCI Matman S.A. which was acquired to the group at the beginning of the year," it said.
